Russian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈzanʲɪtɨj]
  • Audio:(file)

Participle

[edit]

за́нятый • (zánjatyj)

  1. past passive perfective participle of заня́ть (zanjátʹ)

Adjective

[edit]

за́нятый • (zánjatyj) (no comparative)

  1. busy (doing a great deal)
  2. occupied, taken, filled (unavailable for use)
    Э́то ме́сто за́нято? ― Éto mésto zánjato? ― Is this seat taken?
  3. busy, engaged (of a telephone line)
